Updated September 2026
Index Work Record Stories About
Wiki/Jimmy Khounlavong

Overview

Jimmy Khounlavong is a brand architect and product strategist with {{fact:jimmy-khounlavong.27-years}} across brand, sales, and product, from the sales floor to the boardroom. At Common Ground he is Principal, Brand, Product and Merchandising.

Khounlavong spent {{fact:jimmy-khounlavong.16-years}} at Nike across nine roles, rising from the sales floor to General Manager of Nike Sportswear Los Angeles. Before Nike he started at sixteen as a stockroom clerk at Finish Line in Kentucky and sold for Medline and CDW. He holds a BA in Integrated Strategic Communications from the University of Kentucky.

He is the founder of Lip Loi Creative, a brand strategy and go-to-market studio whose operating line is “Creating Brands That Fund.” He also mentors founders through ACEL (Asian Corporate & Entrepreneur Leaders) in Phoenix.

Career, from his own account

Recorded September 19, 2026; figures trace to the Common Ground wins ledger.

Jimmy Khounlavong started at sixteen as a stockroom clerk at a Finish Line in Ashland, Kentucky, worked up to the sales floor and assistant manager, helped staff Final Fours in Indianapolis and filmed the chain's training videos. After a BA in Integrated Strategic Communications from the University of Kentucky he sold medical supplies for Medline in Chicago and Memphis, where surgery packs were the money maker, and then IT for CDW in Chicago for about eighteen months before taking a deliberate step back to enter Nike as an entry-level sales rep.

Nine roles followed over sixteen years. He then led the boutique and energy accounts across Chicago, Cleveland, Detroit and Milwaukee, and moved to Los Angeles to carry Shiekh Shoes, Shoe Palace and the West Coast boutiques that set sneaker culture. As North America footwear merchandising director for Nike Basketball he carried the LeBron 8 through 12, the Kobe 7 through 10, the KD 4 through 7, the first two Kyries and the Paul George inception, worked with the athletes themselves, and brought the Zoom Soldier to market at {{fact:jimmy-khounlavong.usd-125}} to {{fact:jimmy-khounlavong.usd-130}} as the accessible tier under a {{fact:jimmy-khounlavong.usd-210}} signature shoe. As North America marketplace merchandising director he merchandised the spaces for Finish Line and Hibbett, about {{fact:jimmy-khounlavong.usd-500m}} of business, with a team of four; the boutiques were the halo, the chains were the payoff. As men's running merchandising director he owned a {{fact:jimmy-khounlavong.usd-1b-plus}} business through the VaporFly and ran the North America launch of the VaporMax, while Nike's global team seeded the franchise through The Ten. As senior merchandising director for NIKEiD he co-authored the rebrand to Nike By You mid-flight, managing materials rather than SKUs across every geography. He was part of the concepts and ran the launches, including the ACG x Pendleton collaboration at ComplexCon with collector Jay Gordon in November 2017 and the first UV-activated Air Force 1 as the All-Star 2018 Air Force 1, told as the June Gloom story.

He founded Lip Loi Creative on one promise, Creating Brands That Fund, with a two-phase method, market reality then fundability, and a productized ladder. His intake questionnaire is where every brand starts: what the person wants, what motivates them, what they test, which brands they aspire to sit beside. From that he has built full identities for Vincent Hancock, the world-record Olympic skeet champion, and for Luke Kwon, the 390,000-subscriber golf creator who went on to win the inaugural PGA Tour Creator Classic, along with the brand and narrative for the golf docuseries Drive for the Dream, a reconciliation venture founded by a former convict turned lawyer, a sneaker store's mall positioning deck, and Plunge Studio, a contrast-therapy concept. At Lïef he is Principal, Brand, Product and Merchandising. He drew the leaf mark, created the Japandi and Sonoran concept, named the 22 Midtown residences, chose the licensed typefaces, adjusting the kerning of Piala for the logo and adding the diaeresis, and wrote the brand standards, alongside the identity, brand guide, design lookbook and three-tier selections program, and the first pass of the investor deck narrative with Jesse Fowler. The name Lïef came from Jesse. He is a principal and equity partner in Lïef Midtown. For Common Ground he wrote Built. Different., the signature system and the stackable two-page case study the group runs on, and deployed GA4, Schema.org and OG images across all 19 active portfolio projects. He mentors founders through the Asian Corporate and Entrepreneur Leadership organization in Phoenix and holds an Arizona real estate license.

The system was built and largely did not publish.Operating · 2026 FluidmapperKhounlavong built the Fluidmapper brand system, designed and built fluidmapper.com, and produced its conference and sales materials. His partner Jesse Fowler leads the client relationship.Brand · 2026 Fluidmapper datasets gateKhounlavong built a gated download page on fluidmapper.com that trades a sample data package for a name, an email and a stated purpose, and tells the sales inbox who took what.Brand · 2026 Luxury menswear brandKhounlavong built the merchandising buy plan for a luxury menswear brand before launch. His partner Jesse Fowler ran the client relationship, built the data rooms, set the brand up with a vendor for the purchase order, and held the capital work with Prince Capital; go-to-market was shared. The engagement paused in July 2026.Operating · 2026 Principal sitesKhounlavong built or rebuilt the personal sites of all five Common Ground principals, on one shared structure, and put two of them live on Common Ground subdomains.Brand · 2026 Search and AI readinessSearch and AI readiness is the Common Ground standard for making its sites readable to search engines and AI answer engines. Khounlavong wrote the audit method, put the first layer on the sites he controls from April 2026, and graded and fixed the sites by hand. Jesse Fowler was in it early and requested the July 2026 audit.Operating · 2026 Work and seat map The rebuilt site is on staging. It is not live.Brand · 2026 commonground.venturesKhounlavong built and ran the Common Ground site through 2026. He holds 71 of the 72 commits on its main branch, and the other one is his own agent's.Brand · 2026

Lip Loi Creative

Khounlavong wrote a four-pillar scope of work and built the diagnostic that put the consumer first, made the case for showing the technology, and drew the tools a more robust line plan runs on, to SQAIRZ's own models and prices.Brand · 2025 The Negotiated Apology ProjectKhounlavong wrote the brand guidelines, redrew the logo and rebuilt the client's talk as a branded presentation between December 2024 and April 2025.Brand · 2024 to 2025 Aycre CapitalKhounlavong built the brand guidelines, carried the investor deck through 15 saved versions and drew three community brands for a Las Vegas fund that did not close near its target.Brand · 2023 to 2024 Kinetic MLKhounlavong built the pitch deck for a sports science and prediction venture across four versions, from a golf pitch in November 2023 to an all-sports pitch in April 2024. The venture has not gone to market.Brand · 2023 to 2024 Luke KwonKhounlavong built a brand strategy, an identity and a sponsor pitch deck for a golf creator in early 2024. It was presented, and the client chose another route.Brand · 2024 Vincent HancockKhounlavong ran discovery with the Olympic skeet champion, wrote the positioning and built the identity through three versions between July and October 2024.Brand · 2024 Jasper BrandsKhounlavong wrote the product and brand brief for a golf apparel line built to give the unsigned golfers of Drive for the Dream an apparel deal, and to launch with the show. The brief runs from the faults of the standard polo to a nine-item assortment and a production calendar.Brand · 2023 IconicA sneaker boutique was about to take its first mall location and needed to know what it stood for. In two days Khounlavong gave it a position, a customer, an assortment and a store format it could take to landlords and backers.Brand · 2022 No Caller IDKhounlavong curated the voice and the design language of the No Caller ID website, and built brand strategy and deck templates for some of its clients.
